title: hedyotis brevicalyx
intro: Hedyotis brevicalyx, commonly known as Tian Hua Fen, is a type of flowering plant in the Rubiaceae family. It has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, sore throat, and digestive issues, due to its multiple health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Tian Hua Fen include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its use in relieving symptoms of fever and infection. The bioactive constituents of Hedyotis brevicalyx include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
